q: How does the Prakriti quiz work?
a: You answer 12 short questions about how you usually are. Each answer leans Vata, Pitta or Kapha, and your balance of the three becomes your Prakriti. You can retake it any time from your profile.

q: How are my three practices picked?
a: Each day you tell Prana how you feel. Prana combines that mood with your Prakriti, your diet and the time you have, and picks one dinacharya, one ahara and one mantra practice. Every card says why it was picked for you.

q: How does the hum coach listen to me?
a: It uses your phone's microphone while you do Bhramari or Om. It measures how long and how steadily you hum, your breath between hums, loudness and pitch — and gives one technique tip at a time. The audio is analysed on your phone and never uploaded; only the numbers are saved.
